verdict.rationale: Lium documents root access on every pod, and agents can 'connect' to pods and run remote commands via `lium exec`. That covers the root-level control half of the story. The pack never explicitly mentions SSH or bringing your own SSH keys. missing for 10: explicit SSH access documentation, support for uploading or using your own SSH public keys, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: root and Docker-in-Docker on every pod
